description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PM&R) Physician to join our team across multiple premier health and rehabilitation centers in the Bronx/Westchester, NY area. This full-time, non-traveling role offers a competitive annual salary range of $250,000 - $275,000, with a compensation structure heavily weighted towards performance bonuses.

In this unique position, you will rotate between several facilities, dedicating 1-2 days per week at each location. We are specifically looking for a physician with a strong background in Workers' Compensation and No-Fault/Lien cases, as our practice does not involve major medical insurance, Medicare, or Medicaid. The ability to work weekends is a key requirement for this role, ensuring comprehensive patient care.
requirements: Board Certification in Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PM&R)
Minimum of 2 years of experience with Workers' Compensation or No-Fault/Lien cases
Experience managing a patient caseload without reliance on major medical, Medicare, or Medicaid insurance
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $250,000 - $275,000, with compensation heavily weighted towards performance bonuses.

description:
We are urgently seeking an experienced and dynamic Regional Director of Operations to oversee multiple facilities within a premier healthcare organization. This critical leadership role requires a visionary leader dedicated to operational excellence, financial stewardship, and ensuring the highest standards of patient care across the region. This is an urgent hire, and we are looking for a candidate ready to make an immediate impact.

This is an exceptional opportunity for a seasoned professional to join a thriving organization. We offer a highly competitive compensation package, including a significant salary range and comprehensive relocation assistance for qualified candidates. The ideal candidate will be based locally in the Los Angeles area or willing to relocate, as this role does not involve travel.
requirements: Current Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) certification
Must be local to the Los Angeles area or willing to relocate
Proven experience in a regional leadership role within healthcare operations
Strong understanding of multi-facility management and regulatory compliance
Excellent leadership, communication, and financial management skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Highly competitive salary ranging from $200,000 to $300,000+ per year, plus comprehensive relocation assistance.

description:
Join a dynamic home health agency in Orlando, FL, as a dedicated Occupational Therapist. This full-time role offers a unique opportunity to provide essential therapy services to patients in their homes, contributing significantly to their recovery and independence. The compensation structure is attractive, offering $65 per visit.

As an Occupational Therapist, you will be responsible for assessing patients' needs, developing individualized treatment plans, and implementing therapeutic interventions to improve their daily living skills and overall quality of life. This role requires a compassionate professional who can adapt to various home environments and work collaboratively with patients and their families.

We are actively scheduling interviews for this urgent opening, with availability Monday-Friday from 1 PM-7 PM, and over the weekend as needed. If you are a motivated OT looking for a rewarding full-time position with a flexible interview process, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Current Occupational Therapist (OT) license in Florida
Previous experience in a home health setting
Ability to manage a caseload and work independently
